description: This file defines a cultural localization for the Date.js library, specifically for the Sami (Southern) language as spoken in Sweden. It includes cultural specifics such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various helper functions for date manipulation.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: This code extends the Date object with culture-specific data and date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.
